prompt:
You are scouting a single volleyball match from a fixed camera.

CRITICAL: Analyze ONLY the main court in the foreground. Ignore background matches completely.

The vertical net divides the court. For the `side` field, output 'left' if the contacting player is standing on the left side of the net, or 'right' if they are on the right side. Never log the side where the ball lands.

This clip begins at {start:.2f} seconds and runs for 6 seconds.
WARNING: Clips often start MID-RALLY. The first contact you see might be a receive or dig. DO NOT assume it is a serve just because it is early in the clip.

MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE EVENTS (ONE PER CONTACT):
Output EXACTLY ONE event type per physical ball contact. Choose the single best fit.
- If an attack wins the rally, label it ONLY as `kill`.
- If a block wins the point, label it ONLY as `block`.

ACTION DEFINITIONS:
You MUST skip regular passes and dead-time contacts. Only report the pivotal actions defined below:
  serve   - Initiates the rally. Hit from behind the baseline. Even if the toss is off-screen, the first hit starting a rally from the baseline is a serve. NEVER occurs mid-rally. (Back-row hits during play are attacks).
  receive - The FIRST defensive pass handling the opponent's serve. ONLY occurs once per rally. Do not use for passes mid-rally.
  dig     - A defensive pass handling an opponent's hard attack. Usually a low-to-the-ground reaction. Do not report easy passes defending a slow free-ball.
  set     - An assist. ONLY report if it directly sets up a point-winning kill. SKIP ALL OTHER SETS.
  attack  - An offensive action (usually a jump and swing) intentionally directing the ball over the net. (A defensive pass that accidentally goes over is NOT an attack).
  kill    - An attack that immediately wins the rally (lands in or is blocked out).
  block   - A net defense. ONLY report if it immediately scores a point (a stuff block to the floor).

DEAD TIME VETO: Ignore practice hits, practice serves, and post-rally bounces. Contacts after the ball hits the floor are NEVER valid events! A serve is ONLY real if the receiving team is fully in a ready defensive formation.

For each contact give:
  t       - the EXACT moment of physical impact in ABSOLUTE MATCH SECONDS ({start:.2f} + offset). Estimate the offset carefully to one decimal place (e.g. 2.3). Deduplication relies on precise timing!
  type    - one of the seven above
  side    - "left" or "right" (where the player made contact)
  number  - the contacting player's jersey number as a string, or null if unreadable. Do not guess.
  error   - true if this contact was a direct error (hit into the net, out of bounds)
  point   - true ONLY for the final contact if it directly WON the point for the team that made the contact (like a kill). NEVER true for regular passes or errors!

Return an empty list if no valid play happens.
